note: Observed omissions / inconsistencies in current pinned source; not a complete Fluent comparator or implemented fix.

checks.finding: Toggled public state is represented by a CSS class and callbacks, but the component does not itself emit aria-pressed. Caller-supplied AdditionalAttributes could still provide it.
checks.requirement: Toggle button needs an accessible pressed state if it functions as a toggle button.

checks.finding: Current thumb is a div without intrinsic slider role, tabindex, or value ARIA. AdditionalAttributes on the OUTER host can add attributes, but does not make the thumb itself a documented operable slider.
checks.requirement: An operable, labelled slider thumb must be keyboard focusable and expose current/range values.

checks.finding: Both thumb divs lack independent role, focusability, accessible names and value/range semantics; external host attributes cannot label both thumb nodes independently.
checks.requirement: Two separately focusable, named slider thumbs with constant Tab order and dependent ARIA bounds.

checks.finding: ScreenX screen coordinates are subtracted from getBoundingClientRect() viewport coordinates; scroll/window position can introduce offset error.
checks.requirement: Use a consistent coordinate space (e.g., ClientX with viewport rect), and verify with real pointer measurements.

checks.finding: Same mixed coordinate space as Slider, compounded by dependent bounds and thumb selection.
checks.requirement: Use a consistent coordinate space; test crossing, overlap, RTL, Server binding and viewport scroll.

checks.finding: Source creates icon-only remove Button with no explicit accessible name. Needs per-file meaningful accessible naming; no native OS/AT confirmation claimed.
checks.requirement: Icon-only delete buttons must have a programmatic accessible name.

checks.finding: MaxFiles drives the chooser multiple attribute; accept is a browser chooser hint, not server-side validation. Runtime enforcement requires independent investigation.
checks.requirement: Document public MaxFiles; validate count/type/size/authorization on server.
